items.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: Delta Bop had Joe Duffus on drums; Bill Dentzer on trumpet and piano; Jamey Rhind... Mason played guitar; Paul Williams on bass

ctx.x: Do you like that? Because I wasn’t quite sure. I know I’m aware of some of the things you’ve done but probably not all. But you are a person that got bit by the jazz bug.

Yes, big time. Big time. Even before Hamilton, in high school is where I got bit by the jazz bug. And that happened, I actually know the moment. I know the moment it happened. It was at a Tottenville High School stage band concert. Mason Ashe, also a graduate of Hamilton class of ’85, he and I went to junior high school together in Staten Island, Dreyfus Junior High School, then we went to high school together. Because it was junior high school we actually went to ninth grade at Dreyfus. So we went to Tottenville…
Right. And then you ran into Clark Terry here.
